title: Taylor Swift releases "Patient Zero" with Dakota Johnson and Colin Farrell
seoTitle: Taylor Swift releases "Patient Zero" with Dakota Johnson.
subtitle: Singer Taylor Swift unveils today the highly anticipated deluxe album and a teaser for the "Patient Zero" video, already featuring Hollywood stars.
excerpt: Taylor Swift's deluxe album "The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore" drops today, alongside a 13‑second teaser for the "Patient Zero" video starring Dakota Johnson and.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The search for the term "patient zero" exploded after singer Taylor Swift announced the release of her new deluxe album, "The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore," arriving today. The buzz is partly fueled by the recent debut of a 13‑second teaser for the "Patient Zero" music video, the album’s lead single, which reveals the involvement of Hollywood stars Dakota Johnson and Colin Farrell.

The release of "Patient Zero" and Taylor Swift's new album

The highly‑anticipated album "The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore" includes four brand‑new tracks: "Patient Zero," "Cleveland!," "Pink Clouding," and "Babylon!". The full video for "Patient Zero" will premiere at the MTV VMAs next Sunday. At the same ceremony, Taylor Swift will receive the inaugural Director’s Artist award, adding extra spotlight to her latest work.

Dakota Johnson and Colin Farrell in the video

The appearance of Dakota Johnson and Colin Farrell in the "Patient Zero" video was the big reveal in the teaser. Sources say Taylor Swift and Dakota Johnson—both born in 1989 and longtime friends—appear in matching styles in virtually every scene they share. There are hints that a love‑triangle will be explored. Moreover, Johnson’s involvement ties back to comments made in an Emmy sketch with Mariska Hargitay, who mentioned "Saccharide, Aries, From the Vineyard, North or South," with "Sugar" and "Dakota" being obvious references.

Dakota Johnson on the collaboration

Dakota Johnson discussed her role in the music video during the pre‑screening of her new film, "Verity," in London. She expressed her joy working with friends: "Working with your friends is the most fun thing on the planet because we’ve known each other forever, we respect each other’s creative minds, and being able to work side‑by‑side, support each other, and be the person who tells them what to do is wonderful." Johnson also reiterated on a podcast that, although she usually advises against working with friends, the partnership with Taylor was "so much fun. It was the best. We just had a blast." Their friendship runs deep; Johnson attended Taylor Swift’s wedding at Madison Square Garden in July.

The evolution of Taylor Swift’s celebrity circle

Celebrity cameos in Taylor Swift projects are nothing new, as seen previously in the "Opalite" video. The singer’s wedding, for example, was described as a mash‑up of the "Oscars, Grammys, and Emmys." This tradition traces back to the mid‑2010s "Taymerica" era, when the artist gathered friends in Rhode Island. While "Taymerica" has been retired, its spirit has morphed into what some call "Taylor Swift’s Hollywood" or "Taylorwood." Today, instead of beach parties, celebrity friends collaborate on film sets, sharing experiences and fresh ideas through art.

Details of "The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore"

Taylor Swift used her social media to share details about the deluxe album’s creation. She recalled that about a year ago the original "The Life of a Showgirl" album recorded the biggest first‑week sales ever for an album. To celebrate, she traveled to Sweden with collaborators Max and Shellback. "We really just wanted to reflect on how grateful we were for the moment we were in, but there was a studio there and we did what we do when we feel anything: we wrote more songs," Swift explained. She hopes fans love the new tracks, saying they "were born out of pure gratitude for your exuberance and the celebration of the album we made."

With information from LaineyGossip, Variety.
